title: Pilgrims to Flood-Stricken Nepal Sought the Divine at Sacred Mountain
summary: For many, the trek to Mount Kailash on the border of Nepal and Tibet is a once-in-a-lifetime trip to find spiritual awakening.
body_markdown: For many, the trek to Mount Kailash on the border of Nepal and Tibet is a once-in-a-lifetime trip to find spiritual awakening.
